title: The Hog in the Bog
lines: Tom has a hog and a big mop.
The hog hops in a hot bog.
The hog nods and naps in the mud.
Tom got a pot and a rag.
He mops the hog on a log.
The log tips! Tom sits in the mud.
The hog tugs him up on the log.
Tom hugs the hog. He is not mad.

questions.ask: What did Tom get to clean the hog?
questions.listenFor: A pot and a rag. If they name only one, ask "and what else?" and let them go back and find the line.

questions.ask: What happened when Tom mopped the hog on the log?
questions.listenFor: The log tipped and Tom landed in the mud. Have them find the line with the word log in it and read it back to you.

questions.ask: Do you think Tom likes his hog? Tell me why you think so.
questions.listenFor: No wrong answer here. Listen for a reason from the story - the hog tugged him up, or Tom hugged the hog and was not mad.
